get.description: List Wbs Attributes for a given project

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field to sort by. If the field is passed with a - (Example: -name) it is sorted in reverse order. For multiple sort fields, separate  them with a comma (Example: name,-position)

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

id.description: Unique string identifier for this WBS Attribute. Use as the {wbs_attribute_id} path parameter in PATCH/DELETE /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/wbs/attributes/{wbs_attribute_id}, and to associate attribute items via attribute_id.

name.description: Display name of this attribute. Must be unique within the project (e.g. "Cost Type", "Phase"). Maximum 50 characters.

position.description: 1-based display position of this attribute column in WBS code views. Must be unique within the project and between 1 and 3 (a project can have at most 3 attributes). Lower values appear first (leftmost) in the budget code grid.

segment_id.description: ID of the WBS Segment that backs this attribute in the code read model. Read-only internal identifier used to correlate attribute data with segment-level queries. Cannot be filtered on directly through the API.

code.description: HTTP status in screaming snake case (like BAD_REQUEST)

reason_code.description: A machine-readable code that identifies the error specifically enough for the client to interpret what happened and take action.

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")
